integrity: Closed-form proof checked against exact-rational identities and a standalone reproducible numerical illustration; simulations do not prove asymptotics. No independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for an infinite-population common-environment recursion with independently uniform and renewed roundwise two-to-one/unanimity flip probabilities; it does not cover finite-agent noise, groupwise independent environments, or nonuniform/correlated refreshing.
title: Temporal refresh stabilizes the three-person local-flip opinion model with an exact Lyapunov exponent
